title: Counterfactual Neighborhood Risk Fields: Evidence-Grounded Selective Safety for Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.20679v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Representation-based safety defenses for vision-language models (VLMs) often learn to separate harmful from benign inputs, but separation alone does not establish what a risk score means or when it should be trusted. We introduce Counterfactual Neighborhood Risk Fields (CNRF), an evidence-grounded framework for selective VLM safety. CNRF constructs context-matched benign-harmful counterfactual pairs, uses their representation differences as capability-related risk directions, and estimates neighborhood support separately from risk. This separation prevents unfamiliarity from being conflated with harmfulness and enables selective intervention rather than blanket rejection. A victim-adaptive interface accommodates different safety observations across VLM architectures and routes selected requests for same-victim response review, which either releases acceptable candidates or produces constrained alternatives with reduced harmful capability

translated_title: 反事实邻域风险场：面向视觉语言模型的证据支撑型选择性安全
translated_abstract: 基于表示的安全防御方法在视觉语言模型（VLM）中通常学习区分有害输入与良性输入，但仅靠分离本身并不能确立风险分数的含义及其可信的时机。我们提出了反事实邻域风险场，这是一个证据支撑的VLM选择性安全框架。CNRF构建上下文匹配的良性-有害反事实对，将其表示差异用作与能力相关的风险方向，并对邻域支持度与风险进行分离估计。这种分离避免了将不熟悉性与有害性混为一谈，从而实现选择性干预而非一刀切的拒绝。一个受害者自适应接口能够适应不同VLM架构中多样化的安全观察，并将选定的请求路由至同受害者响应审查，该审查要么放行可接受的候选响应，要么生成有害能力降低的受约束替代方案。
tldr: 该论文提出反事实邻域风险场（CNRF）框架，通过构建上下文匹配的良性-有害反事实对并将邻域支持度与风险分离估计，实现了对视觉语言模型有害请求的选择性干预而非一刀切拒绝。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Counterfactual Neighborhood Risk Fields (CNRF), a framework that constructs context-matched benign-harmful counterfactual pairs and separately estimates neighborhood support from risk, enabling selective intervention against harmful VLM requests rather than blanket rejection.
